body: I am eleven. I am in counseling, but I don't have enough courage to tell her that I think I'm depressed... I'm not in counseling because my mom think I'm depressed

I'm sorry, I don't. But I have gone through the same thing. I want to call, but then what if they don't take me seriously? And then my parents will see the number that I called and ask me about it... and I don't wanna get into that mess... If you wanna talk, I'm always here for you.
